title: drosanthemum sessile
intro: Drosanthemum sessile, commonly known as the False Stiff Pelargonium, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. It is native to the Western Cape region of South Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial health benefits. The bioactive constituents present in Drosanthemum sessile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
